findings.title: A drawing entered from above plays with only its bottom edge on screen
findings.where: design.md 3.3 shouldPlay and handler note; R2.2; glossary Play line; MS-8.11; V25; ADR-006 A7; §8 invariant
findings.problem: shouldPlay's first branch (bottom <= 0.7*vh + 1) does not require the top on screen. Scrolling up after a header or footer anchor jump (#how, #proof, #access, #privacy, #faq), or after a fast scroll, a drawing plays when its bottom edge enters, almost entirely above the viewport. This contradicts the §8 invariant. site.mjs only scrolls down.
findings.fix: shouldPlay: return false if bottom <= 0 or top >= vh; if height <= 0.7*vh, require top >= -1 and bottom <= 0.7*vh + 1; otherwise require the whole box in view or (top <= 1 and bottom >= 0.7*vh - 1). Update the glossary, MS-8.11, V25, ADR-006 A7 and the 3.3 note. Add unit cases (216px at 667 with top -200 is false; 520px at 568 with top -300 is false and with top 20 is true). Add a site.mjs case 'MS-8.11 drawings entered from above play in view' at 375x667 and 1280x800: follow #faq, then scroll up.

findings.title: MS-8.13 forbids what MS-8.12 requires for the deferred How picture
findings.where: requirements.md MS-8.13 vs MS-8.12; design.md 3.3 mount bullet; ADR-006 A7
findings.problem: MS-8.13 says any drawing on screen at mount never plays. It is not scoped to data-play roots, and the glossary's Drawing includes the How picture, which MS-8.12 and V26 play from step 1 when deferred. A test or reviewer holding the code to MS-8.13 would flag correct code.
findings.fix: Scope MS-8.13 to data-play drawings, adding '(the desktop How picture follows MS-8.12)', and make the same edit in the 3.3 mount bullet and the ADR-006 A7 bullet.

findings.title: Typed step tables do not type-check with noUncheckedIndexedAccess
findings.problem: tsconfig.base.json sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess, so indexing a readonly array with a number gives T | undefined, and the spread and role() calls fail typecheck.
findings.fix: Type the tables as fixed tuples (SWEEP as 5 Spans, DIGIT_LINE and CHIP as 3 KSteps) and index them with literal unions (Column 0-4, Row 0-2), or map over them. Make reject.diffAt a Column, narrowed in getProofExample.

findings.title: MS-8.12 'whole picture in view' is unconditional, but V22 accepts a cut picture below 632px; the deferred clause says step 1 only
findings.problem: Below an inner height of 632px the picture sticks before step 1 is active and its bottom row is cut. In the deferred case, 3.3 plays step 2 or 3 when a fast scroll skips step 1.
findings.fix: Add 'from an inner height of 632px'. Write 'play the step that became active (step 1 unless a fast scroll skipped it)'.

findings.title: 'The ring is off for motion-jump' overstates the gap between the two presses of 6
findings.where: design.md 3.2 Ring handovers, 4.1 The two presses of 6
findings.problem: The fade-out and fade-in are back to back, so opacity touches 0 only for an instant, a 240 ms dip, not 120 ms off. MS-7.3 is consistent with this; only the prose is off.
findings.fix: Reword: 'the first ring fades out, then the second fades in, so the key visibly dips between the two presses'.

findings.title: Stage table uses a 32px candidate line; the token is 34px
findings.where: design.md 4.1 stage height table, Step 3 row
findings.problem: The candidate line is 34px in tokens.json, so Step 3 sums to 152px, not 150px. That still fits in 160px.
